example.en: Niulang, this child, had a very hard life.

simp.text: 只好跟着哥哥、嫂子一起住。

trad.text: 只好跟著哥哥、嫂子一起住。
trad.bpmf: 只好跟著哥哥、嫂子󠇡一󠇢起住。

example.en: He had no choice but to live with his older brother and sister-in-law.

simp.text: 哥哥跟嫂子想把他分出去。

trad.text: 哥哥跟嫂子想把他分出去。
trad.bpmf: 哥哥跟嫂子󠇡想把他分出去。

example.en: His brother and sister-in-law wanted to send him away.

simp.text: 身边还有这头老牛跟他一起作伴。

trad.text: 身邊還有這頭老牛跟他一起作伴。
trad.bpmf: 身邊還有這頭老牛跟他一󠇢起作伴。

example.en: At least he still had this old ox to keep him company.

simp.text: 牛郎肚子饿得咕噜咕噜叫。

trad.text: 牛郎肚子餓得咕嚕咕嚕叫。
trad.bpmf: 牛郎肚子󠇡餓得󠇡咕嚕咕嚕叫。

example.en: Niulang's stomach growled and rumbled with hunger.

simp.text: 他就靠着山坡搭了个小草屋。

trad.text: 他就靠著山坡搭了個小草屋。
trad.bpmf: 他就靠著山坡搭了個󠇡小草屋。

example.en: He leaned against the hillside and put up a little thatched hut.
He planted rice.

simp.text: 牛郎在山脚下找了块空地。

trad.text: 牛郎在山腳下找了塊空地。
trad.bpmf: 牛郎在山腳下找了塊空󠇡地。

example.en: Niulang found a patch of open ground at the foot of the hill.

simp.text: 谷仓里也堆满了一袋一袋的稻谷。

trad.text: 穀倉裡也堆滿了一袋一袋的稻穀。
trad.bpmf: 穀倉裡也堆滿了一󠇡袋一󠇡袋的稻穀。

example.en: The granary was piled high with sacks and sacks of grain.
A few clouds drifted over from the horizon.

simp.text: 她们在水边有的唱歌，有的跳舞。

trad.text: 她們在水邊有的唱歌，有的跳舞。
trad.bpmf: 她們在水邊有的唱歌，有的跳舞。

example.en: By the water some of them sang and some of them danced.
They played in the water and danced by the Bilian Pond.
Their laughter carried far, far away.
Niulang picked up the red silk scarf.
He hid in the reeds by the pond.

vocab.en: to love each other dearly (lit. to be close and to love, said of a devoted couple)

example.en: The two of them loved each other dearly.
His mother and father passed away.

simp.text: 这头老牛跟他一起作伴。

trad.text: 這頭老牛跟他一起作伴。
trad.bpmf: 這頭老牛跟他一󠇢起作伴。

example.en: This old ox kept him company.

simp.text: 几个仙女轻轻落在池边。

trad.text: 幾個仙女輕輕落在池邊。
trad.bpmf: 幾個󠇡仙女輕輕落在池邊。

example.en: A few fairies landed lightly by the pond.

simp.text: 织女自愿留在人间，跟牛郎成亲。

trad.text: 織女自願留在人間，跟牛郎成親。
trad.bpmf: 織女自願留在人間，跟牛郎成親。

example.en: The Weaver Girl chose to stay in the human world and marry Niulang.

simp.text: 手里捧着她的纱巾，一脸诚恳。

trad.text: 手裡捧著她的紗巾，一臉誠懇。
trad.bpmf: 手裡捧著她的紗巾，一󠇢臉誠懇。

example.en: Holding her scarf in his hands, his face full of sincerity.

vocab.en: fate, the bond that brings people together

example.en: And so they settled a bond that would last a lifetime.

vocab.en: to hit it off, to feel a natural bond

example.en: The more they talked, the more they hit it off.
Such a happy life.

simp.text: 把日子过得甜甜蜜蜜的。

trad.text: 把日子過得甜甜蜜蜜的。
trad.bpmf: 把日子󠇡過得󠇡甜甜蜜蜜的。

example.en: They lived their days sweetly and lovingly.

simp.text: 过了好几年孤苦伶仃的日子。

trad.text: 過了好幾年孤苦伶仃的日子。
trad.bpmf: 過了好幾年孤苦伶仃的日子󠇡。

example.en: He spent many lonely, forlorn years.

simp.text: 两个孩子在一旁无忧无虑地玩耍。

trad.text: 兩個孩子在一旁無憂無慮地玩耍。
trad.bpmf: 兩個󠇡孩子󠇡在一󠇢旁無憂無慮地󠇡玩耍。

example.en: The two children played nearby without a care in the world.
She at once called up the heavenly soldiers and generals.

simp.text: 浩浩荡荡地下凡去捉拿织女。

trad.text: 浩浩蕩蕩地下凡去捉拿織女。
trad.bpmf: 浩浩蕩蕩地󠇡下凡去捉拿織女。

example.en: In a mighty procession they descended to the mortal world to seize the Weaver Girl.
She was so angry she flew into a rage.
